cli.help.llamaswap.residency: Shows or changes which model stays loaded and the TTLs.
cli.help.llamaswap.residency._descriptio:
With no options, shows the residency of the llama-swap config: each model with its group, the
effective TTL and the verdict ("no resident (recommended)" or "resident: X"). Never prints keys or
`cmd`.

Effective TTL: in llama-swap (load.go) a missing `ttl` or -1 means `globalTTL`, which defaults to 0.
So WITHOUT `globalTTL` OR `ttl`, EVERY MODEL HAS AN EFFECTIVE TTL OF 0: none is ever unloaded by
TTL and all of them show up as resident. To leave them with no resident, `--none` then asks for
`--ttl` for all of them.

The config comes from --config; otherwise from LLAMASWAP_CONFIG; otherwise from the one the daemon
uses. If none of those answers, "unknown" and no file is opened.

Writing makes llama-swap (with -watch-config) reload in about 2 s, UNLOAD EVERY MODEL and CUT THE
REQUESTS IN PROGRESS (from any client). That is why nothing is written while local-delegate
delegations are in progress, requests are in flight in llama-swap or models are loaded, nor when
that cannot be known (no daemon and no llama-swap credential in the shell): --now writes anyway.

Before writing, it leaves a <config>.<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.bak copy and replaces the file atomically.
Afterwards it says what llama-swap did: reloaded; rejected (and the copy is restored, so the file
matches what is running); not watching the file (it will apply on the next start); or down.

cli.script.measure_cooldown.exclude_reve: --exclude: the start goes before the end
cli.script.measure_cooldown.help._descri:
Applies the P-4 criterion: whether the cooldown numbers change, stay or it is not known.

Usage:
    uv run python scripts/measure_cooldown.py --since 2026-09-16
    uv run python scripts/measure_cooldown.py --since 2026-09-16 --exclude 2026-09-16T10:00,2026-09-16T11:30
    uv run python scripts/measure_cooldown.py --since 2026-09-16 --json
cli.script.measure_cooldown.help.include: do not apply the windows of test-windows.json (those of --exclude still apply)
cli.script.measure_cooldown.help.since: ISO date; compared against the event's `ts`
cli.script.measure_cooldown.help.tmax: Tmax in force during the window
cli.script.measure_cooldown.outside_p4_n: N, T and Tmax do not change: a candidate is missing, and that is a question about the chains.
cli.script.measure_cooldown.outside_p4_w: WARNING outside P-4: immediate failures exceed 5 % of the delegations.
cli.script.measure_cooldown.removed_by_t: removed by test windows: {rows} rows, {episodes} episodes
cli.script.measure_cooldown.rule.1.reaso: R > 60 %: the model was still broken when it expired
cli.script.measure_cooldown.rule.2.reaso: half or more of the episodes are opened by a read timeout
cli.script.measure_cooldown.rule.3.reaso: R < 20 % and 3 or more diverted operations per episode
cli.script.measure_cooldown.rule.4.reaso: some episode reaches Tmax and re-enters again
cli.script.measure_cooldown.rule_noted: noted for the next window: rule {rule}: {reason}

cli.script.pair_sheet.p15.intro:
In each pair, read the task and both responses (open the source if needed) and write after
"Better (A/B/=):" which one answers the task BETTER: A, B, or = if you see no real difference.
Judge whether it is correct and useful for whoever asked for it, not whether it names more things. Do not open the key.
